themes.label: Burger quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the burgers as delicious and high quality, though a few find them greasy, small or only comparable to other fast food.
quotes: the double shack burger I had from shake shack was the best burger I've ever had to date
Love the burgers perfectly cooked taste like a summer time burger off the grill

themes.label: Crowding and seating
themes.text: Reviewers say the location is packed and finding a table is hard, especially at lunch and dinner rush hours.
quotes: Only drawback is this location is always packed. It is very difficult to get a seat.
it is too small to accommodate the high traffic it receives

themes.label: Waiting time
themes.text: Some report short lines and quick service, while others describe long waits or a late, cold order.
quotes: I have never stood in a line for longer than 2 minutes down here.
Food ordered was 20 min late and served cold.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, efficient staff, but a few mention slow or low-quality service and an argument among staff.
quotes: the staff was very friendly and made for a very personal experience
Food was a five for slightly upscale fast food. Service was a three.

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Several reviewers find the food expensive for the portion size, though some say the quality justifies the cost.
quotes: $5.79 +tax for a shack burger, there is no need keep going up in price.
Great burgers just a little expensive

themes.label: Pizza quality and crust
themes.text: Most reviewers call the pizza excellent, praising the thin, crispy, chewy crust and fresh ingredients, though a few find it good but overrated or imperfect.
quotes: Dough are very chewy and crispy!!! So delicious pizza!
Such great pizza, the flavor is out of this world. Really fresh ingredients that you can taste and smell

themes.label: Long lines and waits
themes.text: Many report long queues and waits, most saying the pizza is worth it, while others found the wait too long or had short waits.
quotes: Love the food, not the line. Every single time I pass this place there is a huge long line.
The line was not a problem. Short wait and quick seating.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Servers are generally described as friendly, quick and helpful, though one reviewer faced seating problems and another an unhelpful answer about reheating food.
quotes: Good and fast service despite being full.
The staff are very courteous and friendly

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some call the pizza good value or worth the price, while others find it overpriced or overrated compared with other New York pizza.
quotes: Great pizza but it's overrated and overpriced and a tad bit too salty.
Pretty cool. Excellent pizza and good price

themes.label: Meatballs and other dishes
themes.text: Meatballs are praised as big and delicious, and salads and some desserts get compliments, though one reviewer disliked the cannoli.
quotes: the meatballs are now up for public grabs and are big, slathered in sauce and delicious

themes.label: Burgers and food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the burgers, fries and other food as delicious and fresh, though a few found the burger ordinary or the shake poor.
quotes: The very best chain hamburger restaurant in NYC. In-N-Out has nothing on Shake Shack!
The food is always hot and fresh.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, fast, helpful staff, while others report rude employees, mishandled orders and poor service.
quotes: The staff is always pleasant and helpful.
Employees are rude, the place is dirty, and I just witnessed the cashier ignore a police officer trying to order a meal.

themes.label: Crowds and waiting
themes.text: The location is often crowded or chaotic, especially around Barclays events, though several say service is still quick.
quotes: Still, they get your food to you quickly and with a smile.
To much going on here it gets extremely chaotic..

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find the food cheap or affordable, while others call it overpriced for ordinary burgers.
quotes: awesome burgers, free water and not too expensive
It was ok I've tasted better burgers for less money.

themes.label: Cleanliness and bathrooms
themes.text: Reviews disagree on cleanliness: some call the place and bathrooms clean, others report dirty bathrooms, unsanitary food handling, or too few bathrooms.
quotes: Always clean, even the bathrooms.
Later in the day when less people were there the bathrooms needed some serious cleaning.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many call the food delicious and fresh, but others find it bland, tasteless, greasy or lackluster, especially burgers and fries.
quotes: Food is just spectacular. Fresh ingredients. Great cocktails, wine selection. Great atmosphere. Good service.
the burger was a bit tasteless and the potatoes were very greasy. I will not come back.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Staff are often described as friendly and accommodating, but several reviewers report slow, inattentive or terrible service and mistaken orders.
quotes: Wait staff and front desk staff are really friendly and nice.
Nice place, but service is slow

themes.label: Atmosphere and live music
themes.text: Reviewers like the vibe, decor, music and live bands, and the pool table, though some find it too loud or crowded.
quotes: The decor is really cool and retro.
Super good service and food. Great vibe. Cool live music .

themes.label: Drinks and bar
themes.text: Cocktails, beer selection and bartenders are widely praised, though one reviewer found the bar out of key drinks and another thought drinks overpriced.
quotes: The food game here was strong, but the drinks were stronger!

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find prices affordable and good value, while others call the place pricey or drinks overpriced.
quotes: Simple dishes, the value for money is excellent.
terrible food and ridiculously overpriced drinks

themes.label: Staff friendliness and attitude
themes.text: Many reviewers found the staff friendly and helpful, while others described them as rude, lazy, unfriendly or inattentive.
quotes: Very friendly & helpful staff. Charging stations at some tables.
Staff here less than friendly. Lady that served me made sure I was made to feel I was taking her away from something more important.

themes.label: Restroom access and condition
themes.text: Reviewers complain the restroom is often closed or out of order, has long lines, is single-occupancy, or is not very clean.
quotes: Always restroom is closed without any reason, always hv to go at a cafe across the street.
Terrible that they claim Restroom closed to actual paying customers.

themes.label: Speed of service and lines
themes.text: Some praise quick service, but others report long lines, slow drinks and too few employees when busy.
quotes: Quick service. Saw them help customers with unique problems such as outdated coupons or a misunderstanding in an order.
The service as a result is always super slow and lines are frequently out the door.

themes.label: Limited seating and crowding
themes.text: Reviewers say the store is busy and crowded, with too little seating, though a few call it spacious.
quotes: Yummy mocha but very small sitting area.
It's a Starbucks. Nothing exciting. Could use more seats.

themes.label: Coffee and food quality
themes.text: Many reviewers enjoyed the coffee and baked goods, such as banana bread and muffins, though a few complained about drinks.
quotes: I recommend banana and nut or red fruit maffins and ham and cheese croasant
Great location with nice staff. Coffee is always great.

themes.label: Price versus portion size
themes.text: Many reviewers find the rolls expensive, often around $18, for small sandwiches, though some say the quality or setting justifies the cost.
quotes: 3 stars because it tastes great but it is NOT worth $18. 2 for $18 would be great.
Good food, a little expensive (as most lobster rolls are) for the size of the sandwich.

themes.label: Lobster roll quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the lobster roll as juicy, fresh and tasty, with several calling it the best they have had.
quotes: THE LOBSTER IS SO JUICY AND SO YUMMY. will definitely come back again for more!
Very fresh lobster, good quality.

themes.label: Bridge views and location
themes.text: Reviewers like the spot under the Brooklyn Bridge, with water and Manhattan views and a pleasant setting for eating.
quotes: Great scenic setting under the bridge.
Great walk and truly intresting panoramic views of Manhattan from Brooklyn.

themes.label: Friendly, quick service
themes.text: Staff are described as friendly, polite and quick, though one reviewer said the service was great but the lobster roll was not.
quotes: AMAZING!! Staff was very friendly. Food was excellent!!
Customer service was outstanding.

themes.label: Cold rolls
themes.text: A few reviewers complained that the rolls were served cold, and one said it upset their stomach.
quotes: $26 for Cold lobster on a cold roll? No thanks.
sandwiches were cold and tiny and a little overpriced.

themes.label: Staff friendliness
themes.text: Many reviewers praise kind, helpful staff, while others describe unfriendly, rude or dismissive employees, including around closing time.
quotes: the workers are very kind and pleasant and the workers are very professional they do a great job with the drinks
Great location. Terribly unfriendly staff.

themes.label: Bathroom availability
themes.text: Reviewers report a single restroom with long lines, or one that was broken, closed, unavailable to customers or missing.
quotes: There is only one bathroom and the line for the bathroom is longer than the one for buying drinks.
When we went there, the bathroom was closed.

themes.label: Slow service and lines
themes.text: Several reviewers describe slow service, long waits and lines, and orders that were wrong or unavailable.
quotes: Ridiculously slow service even though there was no line. I waited and waited and finally just got my money back.
A good atmosphere good hygiene but long line and slow service

themes.label: Cleanliness
themes.text: Some reviewers found tables, bathrooms and the place dirty, while others described a clean environment or good hygiene.
quotes: Very dirty. Tables, bathroom, everything dirty. Very slow attention.
Clean environment fast service

themes.label: Small cozy space
themes.text: The store is described as small with limited seating, yet many find the decor and atmosphere nice and cozy.
quotes: Very nice decor and cozy place.
It's a very small store. There is no toilet.

themes.label: Friendly, fast service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly staff and quick service even when busy, though a couple found staff rude or only ok, and one found ordering strange.
quotes: Ton of options-friendly and fast service
the staff is very friendly and they tend to you fast despite having a lot of people

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Many call the pizza cheap, affordable or fair for the area, though a few find it a bit pricey or poor value.
quotes: Delicious pizza at a great price
Tad bit pricey could be better but great selection

themes.label: Gluten-free and special diets
themes.text: Reviewers appreciate the gluten-free, dairy-free and veggie options, including gluten-free crust, subs and chicken parmigiana.
quotes: lots of options for dairy free and gluten free
Got the gluten-free crust and it tasted delicious!

themes.label: Pizza quality and slices
themes.text: Most praise delicious, classic NY-style slices with big portions, but some found the pizza disappointing, doughy, old or like dollar slices.
quotes: Classic NY pizza. Very large slices. Garlic knots delicious.
Nothing special.. tastes like the dollar slice pizza you get in Manhattan

themes.label: Location, views and photos
themes.text: Reviewers like the DUMBO spot near the waterfront and Manhattan Bridge views, and several stop in around photo outings.
quotes: This is one of the GO TO places for pictures in New York
amazing views of the empire under the manhattan bridge

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers found the Italian food delicious and well made, praising pasta, bruschetta and ricotta, though a few called it bland, simple or nothing special.
quotes: The food here never feels fussy, just the kind of food you wished you cooked at home, perfectly executed.
Pasta is delicious. The Buffalo ricotta bruschette is a must order.

themes.label: Friendly staff and service
themes.text: Staff were mostly described as friendly, attentive and kind, but some reviewers reported slow checks, pressured or poor service.
quotes: The service was attentive and friendly as well with good tips.
Possibly the worst service I've ever had in a restaurant in NY unfortunately.

themes.label: Brunch and breakfast
themes.text: Breakfast and brunch dishes, especially the egg cloud and eggs, were enjoyed by many, though one reviewer was disappointed by the brunch drink knowledge.
quotes: Egg cloud is definitely why you should come here!
Had a great breakfast here. It was just the right size and very tasty.

themes.label: Prices and payment
themes.text: Some found prices high or overpriced, others reasonable or good value; early cash-only policy and a card surcharge and billing complaint were noted.
quotes: Good food and great service. A bit expensive though.
Favorite restaurant in Dumbo! And now they take card!

themes.label: Atmosphere and space
themes.text: Reviewers liked the cozy, lively, industrial setting and location, though some found it cramped, noisy or had trouble with the bench seating and single bathroom.
quotes: The cozy atmosphere is delightful, and management welcoming and attentive.
A bit cramped. Food was tasty. Avoid week-ends.

themes.label: Rooftop views of Manhattan
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the rooftop skyline, harbor and sunset views as the main draw, though one reviewer says the view is not worth it.
quotes: the views of sunset over Manhattan from the top patio are absolutely stunning
Can't beat the views and the pizza is great too

themes.label: Pizza quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the pizza great or good, but some find it mediocre, salty or poor, and the Fungi Misti is singled out.
quotes: Get the large so you can share... Your friends WILL have food envy.
Very poor pizza! View not worth it

themes.label: Service and slow orders
themes.text: Many describe friendly, pleasant staff, while others report slow service, forgotten or lost orders, and rude or indifferent employees.
quotes: served by some of the most pleasant bar staff in Brooklyn
Good food but they might forget about your food for a while.

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Some find prices good or reasonable for a rooftop spot, while others call the food pricey or overpriced.
quotes: The prices are great, considering it's a rooftop restaurant in NYC
Overpriced but great view.

themes.label: Beer and drink selection
themes.text: Reviewers like the bar, sangria and cocktails, but two complain the beer selection is very limited.
quotes: Very limited beer selection. Only 2 choices actually.
Pizza and cocktails are also really good!!

themes.label: Authentic Lebanese food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food as delicious and authentic Lebanese, with mezze, dips, shawarma and lamb singled out, though a few found it only okay.
quotes: If you are looking for authentic Lebanese food, look no further. Literally the BEST Lebanese food I've had in the US.
Baba ganoush was deliciously smooth and smoky. It came with a side of bread.

themes.label: Staff and table service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, helpful, accommodating staff, but some report lies about tables, botched reservations and confused or slow service.
quotes: the staff was incredibly accommodating and welcoming (and we were a large 14-person party)!
I had a reservation at 8 PM and my table was given to another individual.

themes.label: Delivery delays and problems
themes.text: Delivery orders were sometimes very late or never arrived, and one reviewer felt lied to about the order's status.
quotes: They never delivered my seamless food and lied about it.
The delivery takes a bit long sometimes but I love that they're open late.

themes.label: Prices and portion size
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable, but others call it pricey, and mixed grill platters were described as tiny for $30–35.
quotes: the platter was tiny for $30. Disappointing to say the least.
the prices are extremely reasonable

themes.label: Cozy atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers describe the place as cozy and pleasant, with live music mentioned once, though some note it is small or cramped.
quotes: Cozy atmosphere and some of the best food.
Restaurant is cramped, space is tight, not good for large groups.

themes.label: Steak quality
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the steaks, including rib eye and New York strip, as among the best they have had, with ribs also mentioned.
quotes: Literally the best steak I've ever had in my life!
The meat literally melted in my mouth, the hamburger wasn't as special as the steak but still very delicious.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff, but others report rude waitresses, inattention, and frequently changing staff.
quotes: Food was delicious, staff was really nice, always checking up on you, it looks really nice.
Waitresses have a rude tone and have no table manners, need to be trained.

themes.label: Slow food waits
themes.text: Several reviewers report long waits for food or to be attended to, including slow delivery and forgotten tables.
quotes: the last 3 times I came they took WAY too long to bring the food out.
We've waited for 20minutes after being seated before we are tended to.

themes.label: Halal food
themes.text: Reviewers value that the restaurant serves halal steak and American food, treating it as a major plus.
quotes: Some of the best halal food you'll ever eat in your life, fell in love too
Amazing steaks and best of all they are halal

themes.label: Pricing and portions
themes.text: Some find it pricey or overcharged with small portions, while others say the food is worth it or not that expensive.
quotes: It's expensive but the food is worth it.
Kinda pricey and portions are a bit small but good food nonetheless.

themes.label: Vegan and vegetarian options
themes.text: Reviewers praise the vegan and vegetarian choices, especially the Impossible burger, though a few found a veggie or Impossible burger bland or poorly cooked.
quotes: The impossible burger is worth it. The most delicious vegetarian burger I've ever eaten.
They have expanded their vegan menu so much.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many describe friendly, fast, attentive staff, but others report slow service, missing water or condiments, and a two-hour wait.
quotes: Fast, friendly service, quality meat.
No one ever asked if the food was good or if we needed anything else.

themes.label: Burger and side quality
themes.text: Burgers, onion rings and sweet potato fries are widely called delicious, with generous portions, though one reviewer found the beef and chicken burgers unseasoned.
quotes: Best basic burger ever. Best chicken burger ever. Best onion rings ever.
Burgers were very disappointing - beef pattie wasn't seasoned, nor was the fried chicken burger

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Several reviewers find the prices high for burgers, including a full-price charge for a patty side.
quotes: Priced like in a high end restaurant, served in an eatery.
two burgers, without any sides or drinks, is going to set you back over thirty bucks after tax and tip.

themes.label: Beer and drinks
themes.text: Reviewers like the beer selection, mixed drinks and milkshakes, though one noted the milkshake machine was not working.
quotes: Perfect beer selection ever.
If the milkshake machine was working, it'd probably get 5 stars

themes.label: Food quality and flavor
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food as delicious, fresh and flavorful, with specific dishes like mac and cheese, grilled cheese, fries and salmon singled out.
quotes: Delicious , Fresh and Creative food
Get the truffle fries and mix them with the Smoky mac and cheese. Sooo delicious.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff, but some report slow, inattentive or disorganized service, especially when busy.
quotes: extremely friendly staff and amazing food
Poor service! There are a bunch of waiters and waitresses running around with no particular person assigned to one table.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Several find prices fair or good value for the area, while others call it pricey or overpriced.
quotes: Good value for the area
Overpriced and only decent food

themes.label: Atmosphere and seating
themes.text: Reviewers like the lively, comfortable setting with indoor, outdoor and patio seating, though a couple note noise.
quotes: The restaurant has a good atmosphere whether you sit indoor or outdoor (they have a patio section).
Porch was a little noisy.

themes.label: Location near bridge
themes.text: Visitors value the spot near the Manhattan Bridge and photo location, and it suits brunch or lunch.
quotes: Definitely worth the stop while in DUMBO getting that Instagram pic of the Manhattan bridge.

themes.label: Margaritas and cocktails

quotes: Grapefruit Margaritas!!!! So good, and I hate tequila.

themes.label: Service quality

quotes: Good, manageable mezcal list. Excellent service!
our waiter ignored us most of the time and seemed annoyed when asked to explain the menu.

themes.label: Patio and atmosphere
themes.text: The back patio or garden, decor, music and vibe are widely liked, though a few mention loud music or noise.
quotes: really romantic vibe with string lights, and a view of the bridge right above you.
If you go here you MUST sit in the backyard.

themes.label: Price and portions

themes.label: Food flavor and tacos

Bland salsa. Bland beans.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious or excellent, often praising Lebanese dishes such as brussels sprouts, duck shawarma and eggplant, though a few find it only average.

The food here is the 'eyes rolling into the back of your head' kind of good.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many reviewers praise attentive, friendly staff, but others report slow, inattentive or rude service and feeling neglected.
quotes: Fantastic service, very attentive.
Embarrassingly bad service for NYC.

themes.label: Pricing and value
themes.text: Some find it pricey or overpriced for the portions and quality, while others say the food justifies the cost or is a bargain.
quotes: Very expensive for small plates of food that were just okay in flavor.
its a bit pricey but the food stands up to it.

themes.label: Atmosphere and noise
themes.text: Reviewers like the stylish, spacious, lively room and its suitability for groups, but several complain about noise and echo.
quotes: Great food but the acoustics make it so difficult to converse.
Nice lively atmosphere and good food.

themes.label: Burger quality
themes.text: Many reviewers call the burgers among the best they have had, praising taste and juiciness, though a few find them overrated or not special.
quotes: Best burgers ever. Always consistent!
Meh, I don't know what the noise is all about. I've had better burgers in local diners and without standing on line.

themes.label: Crowded, limited seating
themes.text: Reviewers often say the place is packed, with long lines and too few tables, making it hard to sit and enjoy the meal.
quotes: Delicious! but busy room. It's not enough space for you to sit.
the place is packed, you can't find a place to sit down and enjoy your meal.

themes.label: Staff and service

quotes: Employees were so welcoming and cashiers were enthusiastic.
Staff in parts not friendly

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many find prices reasonable and good value, while some call the food overpriced or a bit pricey.
quotes: Definitely competitive prices compared to other chains of the same kind, let's say an unbeatable value for money.
Great food but highly overrated and overpriced.

themes.label: Fries and shakes

quotes: the potatoes are the best I've ever tasted! Crispy on the outside, and tender on the inside!

themes.label: Food quality

quotes: Food was all delicious. Portion sizes were generous. The potato bread was amazing.

themes.label: Service and staff

quotes: But portions were ridiculously small for their prices.

themes.label: Waiting and slow food

quotes: took over an hour for my burger to come out and even then my order was wrong.
I wait for 2 hour just for a lamb

themes.label: Ambience and space

quotes: Beautiful space and excellent food.
Sidewalk seating view is out of this world.

themes.label: Burger quality

quotes: Of the best burgers I've tasted in my life.
Very dry burger with very little sauce; mediocre

themes.label: Crowding and limited seating

quotes: You have to stand and eat if you plan on eating there, which we did.
Always too crowded, a competition to get a table!

themes.label: Speed of service and lines

quotes: The food there is good, but the wait is so long!

themes.label: Staff and service

quotes: workers are always very kind

themes.label: Pricing and value

quotes: the price has only gotten more and more expensive and the burgers have gotten smaller
Delicious burgers and well priced.

themes.label: Unique South Indian dishes

themes.label: Ambiance and vibe
themes.text: Many reviewers like the decor, music and atmosphere, calling it a good date spot, though one found the decor misleading and another too influencer-focused.
quotes: Every detail in the appearance of the restaurant has been thought through and the vibe was great.
the decor is fun, if a bit too obsessed with "influencer" nonsense.

themes.label: Friendly staff and owner

quotes: The owners are lovely and really want you to have a great experience- they ask lots of questions to make sure the meal is perfect for you.
The waiters and waitresses were super rude when serving and acted as if this was a free event.

themes.label: Price and portion size
themes.text: Several reviewers found small portions overpriced, while others said prices were good or that quality ingredients justify the cost.
quotes: A couple of very tasty dishes, but overpriced for small dishes, so I wouldn't go back even though it's in the neighborhood.
A bit more money for some dishes than other spots but you get what you pay for

themes.label: Authentic Lebanese taste
themes.text: Many reviewers, some from Lebanon or the Middle East, call the manousheh authentic and close to home, though one says it is not authentic.
quotes: Most authentic manousheh I've had outside of Lebanon. Delicious.
Easily the most authentic manoushehs I've had outside of Lebanon.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many find it cheap, affordable or good value, while others call it overpriced or say portions are small for the money.
quotes: Great, delicious Lebanese food at affordable prices.
It was yummy, but nothing crazy special. A bit overpriced.

themes.label: Staff and service

The man who took my order was rude

themes.label: Zaatar manousheh

The zaatar is awesome and my favorite

themes.label: Small space

quotes: Tiny place but the food is amazing and you can take it to go!
But the place is so small and there was flies around.

themes.label: Hot dog quality

Cheap and cheerful and you have to go to this Coney Island institution but the hotdogs are way too salty

themes.label: Service and staff attitude

quotes: WAITED. TO. LONG. TO. GET. A HOT. DOG. !!!!

themes.label: Price for value

quotes: Mediocre food. Not worth the price.

quotes: Had dinner at the Prime restaurant, steak was mind blowing.
The food is just overpriced Chinese and fast food.

themes.label: Staff and floor service
themes.text: Some find staff friendly and service great, but others report too few cashiers and floor agents, slow help and lack of service.

Friendly staff and crowd. Cant wait to go back

themes.label: Security and safety
themes.text: Opinions split: some praise visible security and cleanliness, while others cite weak security, fights and shady people.
quotes: most importantly security for everyone
8 out of 10 times there's always a fight; people that go there behave crazy

themes.label: Pastrami and sandwich quality

quotes: Best pastrami in the world. A must everytime I'm in New York!
the meat is incredibly flavory and tender. This is a must go in NY.

themes.label: Long lines and waits

quotes: Long lines but worth the wait.
Always busy but lines move quickly.

themes.label: Huge portions

sandwiches so thick you will not go hungry

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Many call the sandwiches expensive, around $20 or more, though several say the quality justifies the cost.

it's food is way overrated and expensive

themes.label: Ticket system and ordering
themes.text: Some visitors found the ticket system, multiple lines and self-seating confusing or overwhelming.

you need to know the system if your going to order and seat yourself

themes.label: Steak quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the porterhouse and steak outstanding, often the best in New York, though a few find it overrated or only okay.

themes.label: Service and staff

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Reviewers note the high cost; many say it is worth it, while some call it overpriced or a trap.

slightly over priced but overall worth a visit

themes.text: The thick-cut bacon, creamed spinach and onion rings earn praise, though one reviewer found the sides mediocre.
quotes: The bacon is amazingly thick, crunchy and flavorful.
Skip the sides they're mediocre at best.

themes.label: Basement food hall variety
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the basement food hall for its wide variety of stalls, price points and tastes, though a couple found it overpriced, limited or crowded.

good options at a variety of price points

themes.label: Staff and service

Not to be missed iconic landmark in NYC

themes.label: Bar drinks and tea

themes.text: Reviewers praise the food overall and name pastas, chicken parmesan, shrimp dishes and calamari, with only a few complaining about flavor or a weak dish.
quotes: Excellent chicken parmesan and shrimp scampi.
The fettuccine Alfredo had a weird fishy taste to it though.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Reviewers split on the food: some call it delicious or excellent, while many find it average, bland, cold or underwhelming.
quotes: This restaurant is quality over quantity. Prices are very high, but the food is out of this world.
This food is average slightly dry and bland.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Most reviewers call it expensive for small portions, though a few find the prices fair or cheap.
quotes: So bloody expensive for so little food. A pasta dish was $16 and barely enough to feed a child
waiter at your service constantly, very cool place, and the top is that it's cheap

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many praise friendly, prompt servers, but others report slow, inattentive or rude service, forgotten food and a rude host.
quotes: Bad service. Too long to be attended. Regular food. Poor cleaning.
Luis served us and was very prompt to answer our request. A very pleasant experience.

themes.label: Movie memorabilia theme
themes.text: Film props, costumes and the themed atmosphere are a draw, especially for film fans and families with kids.
quotes: a ton of movie memorabilia to keep ur eyes busy while waiting for your food
it is an ideal thematic place to go with children.

themes.label: Dated decor and cleanliness
themes.text: Several reviewers say the place feels old and needs a makeover, with dusty memorabilia, a leaking ceiling and a dirty glass.
quotes: Planet Hollywood is not the place it once was, everything look and feels dated now.
could use a good dusting

themes.label: Music and DJs
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the DJs and the variety of music, including Latin and hip hop, though one found the DJs poor and another found it too loud.
quotes: DJ's plays all types of music, all the latest hits from Latin to Hip hop.
Food is delicious and the DJs keep the party popping.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food excellent or flavorful, while others found it only okay, cold, dry or lacking vegetarian choices.
quotes: Plenty of flavor in the food. If you like Spanish food this is the place.
Sat down to an order of cold broccoli and carrots.

themes.label: Service and waiting
themes.text: Some praise friendly staff and attentive bartenders, but many describe long waits for seating despite reservations, slow food and rude staff.
quotes: We made reservations and still had to wait to be seated.

themes.label: Drinks and pricing
themes.text: Drinks are often called strong and good, but several reviewers complain about pricey drinks and prices that differed from what they were told.
quotes: They have 2 bars, drinks are pricey but strong.
The bartenders was charging different prices for the same drink

themes.label: Dress code and door
themes.text: Reviewers say the dress code is enforced inconsistently or strictly, and one complains about a misleading free-entry promise.
quotes: Always making up the dress code at the door
But very strict dress code. No sneakers!!!

themes.label: Long waiting times
themes.text: Many reviewers warn of long waits, sometimes up to two hours, though some say it was worth it and a few were seated quickly.
quotes: Come at a silly time or else be prepared to wait... and wait... and wait...
Wait was almost 90 minutes on a Friday night.

themes.label: Ramen quality
themes.text: Most praise the broth, noodle texture and flavor, some calling it the city's best, while others find it overrated, too salty or with hard noodles.
quotes: The broth is super rich and the noodles with just the right amount of chew and bounce.
The noodles too hard and soups only taste salty very salty.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers describe the place as fun, lively and inviting, with a pleasant mood and decor, though one found the music too loud.
quotes: I love the atmosphere, which is always inviting.
delicious food, fun vibe and very reasonably priced for the quality and experience

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most describe friendly, attentive and quick service, but a few found staff unfriendly, rushed or declining over time.
quotes: The staff is attentive, but not crowding.
Unfortunately, service has been on a downwards trend and it no longer feels as welcoming or service minded

themes.label: Pork buns and sides
themes.text: Pork buns and other small plates are repeatedly praised as delicious.
quotes: The pork steamed buns were the best I've ever had.

themes.label: Burger quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the burgers as tasty and well cooked, though a few found them bland, overcooked or disappointing.
quotes: You won't be let down by their burgers that's for sure!
Burgers are really well cooked and yummy!

themes.label: Service speed and friendliness
themes.text: Many describe quick, friendly service, but others report inattentive, slow or rude servers and one complaint about an unauthorised tip.
quotes: Great food and speedy service! Will definitely return and recommend.
Food was really good however server wasn't. Asked several times for things and never got them.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Most find prices fair or good value for the area, while a few call it expensive or note costly extras.
quotes: Good food, efficient service at a very reasonable price for the area in which it is located.
Very expensive to eat 3 hamburgers

themes.label: Waiting for a table
themes.text: Busy times led to long waits for seating and for service, according to several reviewers.
quotes: Gets very crowded and can take a while to be seated.

themes.label: Atmosphere and seating
themes.text: Reviewers like the relaxed, spacious room with plenty of screens, but mention loud music, small tables and uncomfortable seats.
quotes: Music is very loud. This makes having a pleasant conversation during dinner almost impossible.
They can serve you upstairs or down

themes.label: Fast, quick service
themes.text: Many reviewers say lines move fast and orders arrive quickly, even at busy lunch times in Midtown.
quotes: They take your order on a tablet while you're standing in line, so don't let the line intimidate you.
I had my food as soon as i left the register and it was lunch time in midtown!

themes.label: Limited seating
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly say there is too little space to sit and eat, though some accept it for New York.
quotes: But the lack of seating is a minus. Especiallyif your gonna serve a dinner crowd.
No place to sit, but what else can you expect in NYC.

themes.label: Friendly staff
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, helpful employees, but a few report rude counter staff and poor customer service.
quotes: The workers are also super nice and they remember me by face
Service was bad, cashier was rude and didn't say thank you, she didn't offer me dipping sauce

themes.label: Chicken sandwiches and food
themes.text: Reviewers praise the taste of the chicken sandwiches, waffle fries, sauces and shakes.
quotes: Juicy, tastey and crispy chicken sandwiches
Their waffle fries are so amazing, I would 100% recommend it.

themes.label: Order mistakes and disorganization
themes.text: Some reviewers report wrong orders, disorganized layout and long waits that hurt their visit.

They gave me the wrong order, and I didn't realize it until I left

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many reviewers praise attentive, friendly and fast service, but others describe inattentive, rude or error-prone servers and one server for a large party.

themes.label: Long waits
themes.text: Reviewers report slow entrees, pickup orders not ready on time and generally long waits, though one found a full house still fast.

appetizers came out quickly but waited a long time for the entree to come

themes.label: Wings and drinks
themes.text: Sticky wings, Hennessy sauce wings and frozen or frosty cocktails are repeatedly singled out as favorites.
quotes: Amazing wings, great service, nice atmosphere. The hennesey sauce is to die for.
Good place to eat. Love the frosty cocktails.

themes.label: Crowded, noisy room
themes.text: Some enjoy the lively, party atmosphere, while others find it too crowded, noisy, small or cramped with chairs close together.
quotes: Crowded go early, chairs too close to each other
The atmosphere is lively, the music keeps it interesting

themes.label: Food quality inconsistent
themes.text: Many call the food delicious with big portions and good value, but others report bland, cold, rotten or disappointing dishes.
quotes: Great service, large portions and great food for an amazing price.
the steak was tender but bland...the bbq ribs was basically grissle

themes.label: Attentive, friendly service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise attentive, helpful staff, though one reviewer found a server rude and another called service poor.
quotes: Staff are everywhere and fully attentive as they zip by with various skewered meats.
And the service was top notch. My glass was never empty and the entire staff was so happy to help.

themes.label: Quality of the meats
themes.text: Most praise the variety, taste and quality of the meats, but a few found them salty or low quality.
quotes: Best meats served to your liking. Amazing salad bar with all the fixings. Love this place.
Meats are so salty overall and salad bar is not so great.

themes.label: Price and value

Is it worth the price "NO WAY".

themes.text: Reviewers frequently single out the salad bar as excellent or a highlight, though a couple found it unimpressive.
quotes: Lots of food, expensive, EXCELLENT salad bar
The salad bar is worth the trip in itself.

Noisy, chaotic, not a pleasant experience.

Great food terrible music I guess if you're into loud Cuban music.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Servers are mostly described as friendly and attentive, though some reported slow service, mistakes or dropped plates.

waited for 35 min and never got my lime I asked for.

themes.label: Mojitos and drinks
themes.text: Mojitos and other cocktails are frequently praised, with a few complaints about weak or poorly poured drinks.

Food was delicious! Drinks were not great. Measured pour :(

themes.label: Price and portions

Food is good but pricey for small portions.

A great assortment of restaurants, and market-style shops. A great place to go and grab a bite with friends.

themes.label: Fresh produce and groceries

quotes: Excellent place to get fresh fruits and vegetables and from different countries
Fresh fruit and vegetables Meats and Seafood at great prices

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable or cheaper than supermarkets, while others say the new market has become pricey, with some vendors very expensive.
quotes: It seems a bit pricier, but you can't fault them for that.
You can get lunch there for under $10 and enjoy the ambiance of the space!

themes.label: New space and seating
themes.text: Many like the new, clean, spacious building with plenty of seating, though some miss the old market and one wants more seating and bathrooms.
quotes: Great quality and huge space upstairs for sitting.
I wish they had more seating and an easy to find bathroom.

themes.label: Old market nostalgia
themes.text: Several reviewers miss the old market's character, though many are glad the community feel and vendors were largely kept.

While I love the openness of this new location, it really makes me miss the old one.

themes.label: Waterfront and bridge views

Best view of the city especially at sun down

themes.label: Concerts and events
themes.text: Many visitors came for rooftop concerts and events and found it a great venue, though some had complaints about sound and entry lines.
quotes: Great place for a concert. Must go to
Here for Ringo Starr anf his All Star Band, a great concert venue.

themes.label: Limited shops and food
themes.text: Several reviewers found few shops, restaurants or things to do, with the old mall gone and the development still unfinished.
quotes: Great venue. Lack of food options though.
I'm disappointed that the mall isn't even a mall anymore.

themes.label: Rooftop ice skating
themes.text: Visitors enjoyed the elevated ice skating rink in winter, calling it amazing and fun.
quotes: Rooftop ice skating was amazing!
So much fun and I absolutely love the ice skating rink!

themes.label: Staff, security and queues
themes.text: A few reviewers complained about poor service, long security lines and unenforced no-smoking rules, while one praised helpful staff and funny bartenders.
quotes: A 30 minute queue for security is unacceptable.

themes.label: Pepperoni square slice

Try the rectangular pepperoni slices -- they come fresh out of the oven and are unbelievably good.

themes.label: Long lines and waits

themes.label: Small space, no seating
themes.text: Reviewers note the shop is tiny with no seats, so people eat standing at counters or on the sidewalk.
quotes: No real spots to eat so be prepared to eat standing somewhere on the sidewalk.

themes.label: Staff attitude

The staff can be more friendly and helpful.

themes.label: Price

themes.label: Long waits

themes.label: Chicken and waffles

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many find staff friendly and polite, but others report slow, rushed, unfocused or rude service.

themes.label: Cash only payment
themes.text: Reviewers are bothered that the restaurant does not take cards, though one says dinner allows credit cards.
quotes: For such a busy place, a bit disappointing not to take credit cards.

themes.label: All-you-can-eat value

quotes: For 28$ it's all you can eat for two hours. That's insane!
Great all-you-can-eat deal. It's not phenomenal but it's a really good deal and hits the spot.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many praise friendly, fast service, but others report rude staff, little attention at the table, or poor service.

themes.label: Sushi freshness and quality

the sushi though good for the all you can eat price is not as good as a alacart restaurants

themes.label: iPad ordering system

I like how they can order from an iPad

quotes: You cannot decrease the built in tip.
there is a non-optional 18% service fee added to the bill

A large selection of foods under one roof.

themes.label: Rooftop and bridge views

it is located in a place with a breathtaking view, especially in the evening.

themes.label: Prices

quotes: Great food at an affordable price.

themes.label: Crowds and noise

Music was waaaaay to loud.

themes.label: Slow disorganized service

quotes: Slow service and confused staff at multiple of the restaurants.
took over an hour to be delivered as the staff was somewhat disorganized

themes.label: Service quality

The service is great too as they serve fast. All the waitress are patient

themes.label: Value and price

not worth the money, especially if you come in a large group.

quotes: The birthday discount is a great deal (free meal the day of, or within three days of your birthday if you bring a cake).
Birthday people eat for free.

themes.label: Hot pot and BBQ food

quotes: You have to literally chase down condescending wait staff for water, bill, etc...
Good food, good service - they care to give you the hot ones.

themes.label: Dim sum food quality

Very good Chinese food. Delicious shrimp dumplings.

themes.label: Huge noisy dining hall

quotes: My non Chinese friends are always shocked by the enormous space here. Come for the atmosphere.
Too loud, and big. More of a party hall than a restaurant.

themes.label: Weekend waits and crowds

The wait can be a little long on weekends. Come early and you won't wait that long.

themes.label: Prices and value

quotes: Paid $40 for 11 dishes and that was a perfect lunch a party of 4!

themes.label: Crust, sauce and cheese quality

themes.label: Loud music and atmosphere

themes.label: Friendly staff and bar

they only had a couple slices out, and said it would be a two hour wait if I wanted to order a pie

themes.label: Burger and fries quality

themes.label: Small portions, high price

it is very expensive for what it offers they sell everything separately and there are hardly any packages

quotes: Plenty of seats and very comfortable to dine.

themes.label: Long waits

it may not be worth a long wait as there are many other brunch spots nearby.

its decorated like an old-time shop.

the line moved really quickly

table sharing with strangers, no special requests or deviation from menu

themes.text: Many reviewers say the seafood and other food was fresh, including shrimp, oysters, clams and crab.
quotes: Everything very fresh and well cooked. We ordered clams, shrimp and mussels.
Is the best crab restaurant...everything is fresh....the prices are very good compared to the other restaurants

themes.label: Fair, affordable prices
themes.text: Many reviewers describe prices as reasonable or affordable, though one says it is pricey for the portion size.
quotes: Such good food and affordable prices. Superb experience!
The food is really good although it is pricey for its portion.

themes.label: Fast, friendly service
themes.text: Reviewers praise quick food and friendly, helpful staff and servers.
quotes: Our waiter was awesome. Service fast and on point. Your food comes out very quick.
They walked me through the menu explaining what my options were and recommended some choices that were the best value

themes.label: Cleanliness
themes.text: Several reviewers mention the restaurant and food being clean.
quotes: It's very clean, food is great ,is delicious and the price is just right.
I really like this location, clean, convenient, and delicious food.

themes.label: Room and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers describe the place as large, with a good atmosphere and ambiance.
quotes: Great atmosphere and ambiance...
The place is huge, They have Hush puppies and fried shrimp basket.

themes.label: Slow service and long lines
themes.text: Many reviewers describe slow service, long lines and drive-thru waits, though a few others call the service quick despite the crowds.
quotes: Slowest customer service 30 people in line and only 1 person working the dine in line very LAZY
Horrible drive thru. They added 2 order points and it's infinitely slower.

themes.label: Order accuracy mistakes
themes.text: Reviewers report wrong or incomplete orders, such as missing items and incorrect drinks, and advise checking the bag before leaving.
quotes: you ALWAYS have to check your bag before you drive out the drive-thru because they stay leaving something out your order
Each time I've been to this Wendy's my order was made incorrectly

themes.label: Food quality and temperature
themes.text: Some praise fresh, hot, tasty food, while others report cold food, terrible nuggets or skimpy toppings like tiny lettuce pieces.
quotes: The food is always fresh and hot.
My chicken tenders were ice cold.

themes.label: Cleanliness and dining room
themes.text: Many call the restaurant clean, renovated and spacious, but some mention dirty tables, unkempt bathrooms or a restaurant that is not clean.
quotes: The service is fast and the place is very clean and nice
sometimes the bathroom and dining areas are unkempt

themes.label: Staff friendliness
themes.text: Several reviewers describe the staff and managers as nice, helpful and professional, though one mentions a rude counter attendant.
quotes: Love this place. The staff is very nice
my go to Wendy's and they are never rude

themes.label: Table service quality
themes.text: Many reviewers praise friendly, attentive, fast service, while others report slow or inattentive waitstaff, long waits for the check, and unhelpful or unfriendly servers.
quotes: Insanely slow service. Waited forever for our check, despite asking multiple employees to find server.

themes.label: Frozen and large drinks
themes.text: Reviewers frequently love the oversized Texas-sized frozen margaritas and piña coladas and consider the drinks excellent, though one finds them pricey and one dislikes the two-drink limit.
quotes: the Texas sized margaritas fill your heart with alcoholic joy.
My favorite drink of any place ever!! The texas sized pina colada with the extra shot!

themes.label: Wings and BBQ food
themes.text: Ribs, wings and shrimp earn praise, but others found food dry, sloppy, undercooked or mediocre, and one said the ribs were cut small.
quotes: The wings are delicioud, humongous and fresh!
The food was not that great , it was either dry or sloppy , the burgers were dry !

themes.label: Crowded noisy space
themes.text: Several reviewers describe a small, crowded, noisy room with tables too close together, though some like the lively atmosphere.
quotes: A bit crowded people are almost on top of each other food and drinks o.k. atmosphere very noisy

themes.label: Delivery and ordering problems
themes.text: Reviewers report late, cold or incorrect delivery orders and wrong menu prices on the website.
quotes: It is now 8:13pm and I still have not got my food!
When ordering off the website the menu prices are completely wrong so ask how much the food is while on the phone
